formal_scope: The time shifts realized along an entire continuous path by a compact spatial group form a closed additive subgroup of the real line.
That subgroup is cyclic or the whole line. Two incommensurate shifts guarantee a spatial multiplier for every shift.
An injective energy on the physical half-line with two multiplicative return laws forces their time maps to commute.
analytical_scope: Backward and forward uniqueness of smooth immersed free elastic flows and the extension of any matching pair to the entire time orbit.
The common spatial and temporal centres, the identification of log return factors with positive group elements and the geometric fourth-root length bounds.
Recovery of a single angular coefficient modulo rotational symmetries and treatment of multiply covered circles.
The positive-time analytic continuation of a matching arclength arc, and use of constant covering multiplicity to recover a return of the complete immersions.
A similarity equation with fixed coefficients on one positive-time arc, or at arclength labels with a finite accumulation point, determines a continuously self-similar geometric flow.
